message.content: Here's your three-sentence update: President Trump suggested the U.S. could stay in Iran and "keep the oil," predicting gas prices would fall once the war ends, while Iranian state media reported a cargo vessel was struck near Qeshm Island in the Strait of Hormuz, killing one and injuring four. Domestically, industry leaders are calling for AI development to slow down for safety reasons, and Trump is set to campaign for GOP candidates ahead of the midterms. Elsewhere, a federal judge ruled the Trump administration broke the law in directing FEMA's workforce be cut in half, the EPA is set to repeal carbon pollution standards for coal and gas power plants, and Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of Congo have topped 7,000.
